nodes.title: Authorized Access Control
nodes.description: Limit information system access to authorized users, processes acting on behalf of authorized users, or devices (including other information systems). • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.i • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.1

nodes.title: Transaction & Function Control
nodes.description: Limit information system access to the types of transactions and functions that authorized users are permitted to execute. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.ii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.2

nodes.title: Control CUI Flow
nodes.description: Control the flow of CUI in accordance with approved authorizations. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.3

nodes.title: Separation of Duties
nodes.description: Separate the duties of individuals to reduce the risk of malevolent activity without collusion. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.4

nodes.title: Least Privilege
nodes.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, including for specific security functions and privileged accounts. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.5

nodes.title: Non-Privileged Account Use
nodes.description: Use non-privileged accounts or roles when accessing nonsecurity functions. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.6

nodes.title: Privileged Functions
nodes.description: Prevent non-privileged users from executing privileged functions and capture the execution of such functions in audit logs. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.7

nodes.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
nodes.description: Limit unsuccessful logon attempts. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.8

nodes.title: Privacy & Security Notices
nodes.description: Provide privacy and security notices consistent with applicable CUI rules. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.9

nodes.title: Session Lock
nodes.description: Use session lock with pattern-hiding displays to prevent access and viewing of data after a period of inactivity. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.10

nodes.title: Session Termination
nodes.description: Terminate (automatically) a user session after a defined condition. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.11

nodes.title: Control Remote Access
nodes.description: Monitor and control remote access sessions. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.12

nodes.title: Remote Access Confidentiality
nodes.description: Employ cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of remote access sessions. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.13

nodes.title: Remote Access Routing
nodes.description: Route remote access via managed access control points. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.14

nodes.title: Privileged Remote Access
nodes.description: Authorize remote execution of privileged commands and remote access to security-relevant information. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.15

nodes.title: Wireless Access Authorization
nodes.description: Authorize wireless access prior to allowing such connections. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.16

nodes.title: Wireless Access Protection
nodes.description: Protect wireless access using authentication and encryption. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.17

nodes.title: Mobile Device Connection
nodes.description: Control connection of mobile devices. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.18

nodes.title: Encrypt CUI on Mobile
nodes.description: Encrypt CUI on mobile devices and mobile computing platforms. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.19

nodes.title: External Connections
nodes.description: Verify and control/limit connections to and use of external information systems. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.iii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.20

nodes.title: Portable Storage Use
nodes.description: Limit use of portable storage devices on external systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.21

nodes.title: Control Public Information
nodes.description: Control information posted or processed on publicly accessible information systems. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.iv • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.1.22

nodes.title: Role-Based Risk Awareness
nodes.description: Ensure that managers, systems administrators, and users of organizational systems are made aware of the security risks associated with their activities and of the applicable policies, standards, and procedures related to the security of those systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.2.1

nodes.title: Role-Based Training
nodes.description: Ensure that personnel are trained to carry out their assigned information security-related duties and responsibilities. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.2.2

nodes.title: Insider Threat Awareness
nodes.description: Provide security awareness training on recognizing and reporting potential indicators of insider threat. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.2.3

nodes.title: System Auditing
nodes.description: Create and retain system audit logs and records to the extent needed to enable the monitoring, analysis, investigation, and reporting of unlawful or unauthorized system activity. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.1

nodes.title: User Accountability
nodes.description: Ensure that the actions of individual system users can be uniquely traced to those users, so they can be held accountable for their actions. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.2

nodes.title: Event Review
nodes.description: Review and update logged events. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.3

nodes.title: Audit Failure Alerting
nodes.description: Alert in the event of an audit logging process failure. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.4

nodes.title: Audit Correlation
nodes.description: Correlate audit record review, analysis, and reporting processes for investigation and response to indications of unlawful, unauthorized, suspicious, or unusual activity. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.5

nodes.title: Reduction & Reporting
nodes.description: Provide audit record reduction and report generation to support on-demand analysis and reporting. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.6

nodes.title: Authoritative Time Source
nodes.description: Provide a system capability that compares and synchronizes internal system clocks with an authoritative source to generate time stamps for audit records. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.7

nodes.title: Audit Protection
nodes.description: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.8

nodes.title: Audit Management
nodes.description: Limit management of audit logging functionality to a subset of privileged users. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.3.9

nodes.title: System Baselining
nodes.description: Establish and maintain baseline configurations and inventories of organizational systems (including hardware, software, firmware, and documentation) throughout the respective system development life cycles. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.1

nodes.title: Security Configuration Enforcement
nodes.description: Establish and enforce security configuration settings for information technology products employed in organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.2

nodes.title: System Change Management
nodes.description: Track, review, approve or disapprove, and log changes to organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.3

nodes.title: Security Impact Analysis
nodes.description: Analyze the security impact of changes prior to implementation. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.4

nodes.title: Access Restrictions for Change
nodes.description: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.5

nodes.title: Least Functionality
nodes.description: Employ the principle of least functionality by configuring organizational systems to provide only essential capabilities. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.6

nodes.title: Nonessential Functionality
nodes.description: Restrict, disable, or prevent the use of nonessential programs, functions, ports, protocols, and services. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.7

nodes.title: Application Execution Policy
nodes.description: Apply deny-by-exception (blacklisting) policy to prevent the use of unauthorized software or deny-all, permit-by-exception (whitelisting) policy to allow the execution of authorized software. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.8

nodes.title: User-Installed Software
nodes.description: Control and monitor user-installed software. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.4.9

nodes.title: Identification
nodes.description: Identify information system users, processes acting on behalf of users, or devices. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.v • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.1

nodes.title: Authentication
nodes.description: Authenticate (or verify) the identities of those users, processes, or devices, as a prerequisite to allowing access to organizational information systems. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.vi • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.2

nodes.title: Multifactor Authentication
nodes.description: Use multifactor authentication for local and network access to privileged accounts and for network access to non-privileged accounts. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.3

nodes.title: Replay-Resistant Authentication
nodes.description: Employ replay-resistant authentication mechanisms for network access to privileged and non-privileged accounts. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.4

nodes.title: Identifier Reuse
nodes.description: Prevent reuse of identifiers for a defined period. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.5

nodes.title: Identifier Handling
nodes.description: Disable identifiers after a defined period of inactivity. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.6

nodes.title: Password Complexity
nodes.description: Enforce a minimum password complexity and change of characters when new passwords are created. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.7

nodes.title: Password Reuse
nodes.description: Prohibit password reuse for a specified number of generations. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.8

nodes.title: Temporary Passwords
nodes.description: Allow temporary password use for system logons with an immediate change to a permanent password. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.9

nodes.title: Cryptographically-Protected Passwords
nodes.description: Store and transmit only cryptographically-protected passwords. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.10

nodes.title: Obscure Feedback
nodes.description: Obscure feedback of authentication information. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.5.11

nodes.title: Incident Handling
nodes.description: Establish an operational incident-handling capability for organizational systems that includes preparation, detection, analysis, containment, recovery, and user response activities. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.6.1

nodes.title: Incident Reporting
nodes.description: Track, document, and report incidents to designated officials and/or authorities both internal and external to the organization. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.6.2

nodes.title: Incident Response Testing
nodes.description: Test the organizational incident response capability. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.6.3

nodes.title: Perform Maintenance
nodes.description: Perform maintenance on organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.1

nodes.title: System Maintenance Control
nodes.description: Provide controls on the tools, techniques, mechanisms, and personnel used to conduct system maintenance. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.2

nodes.title: Equipment Sanitization
nodes.description: Ensure equipment removed for off-site maintenance is sanitized of any CUI. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.3

nodes.title: Media Inspection
nodes.description: Check media containing diagnostic and test programs for malicious code before the media are used in organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.4

nodes.title: Nonlocal Maintenance
nodes.description: Require multifactor authentication to establish nonlocal maintenance sessions via external network connections and terminate such connections when nonlocal maintenance is complete. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.5

nodes.title: Maintenance Personnel
nodes.description: Supervise the maintenance activities of maintenance personnel without required access authorization. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.7.6

nodes.title: Media Protection
nodes.description: Protect (i.e., physically control and securely store) system media containing CUI, both paper and digital. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.1

nodes.title: Media Access
nodes.description: Limit access to CUI on system media to authorized users. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.2

nodes.title: Media Disposal
nodes.description: Sanitize or destroy information system media containing Federal Contract Information before disposal or release for reuse. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.vii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.3

nodes.title: Media Markings
nodes.description: Mark media with necessary CUI markings and distribution limitations. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.4

nodes.title: Media Accountability
nodes.description: Control access to media containing CUI and maintain accountability for media during transport outside of controlled areas. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.5

nodes.title: Portable Storage Encryption
nodes.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to protect the confidentiality of CUI stored on digital media during transport unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.6

nodes.title: Removable Media
nodes.description: Control the use of removable media on system components. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.7

nodes.title: Shared Media
nodes.description: Prohibit the use of portable storage devices when such devices have no identifiable owner. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.8

nodes.title: Protect Backups
nodes.description: Protect the confidentiality of backup CUI at storage locations. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.8.9

nodes.title: Screen Individuals
nodes.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to organizational systems containing CUI. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.9.1

nodes.title: Personnel Actions
nodes.description: Ensure that organizational systems containing CUI are protected during and after personnel actions such as terminations and transfers. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.9.2

nodes.title: Limit Physical Access
nodes.description: Limit physical access to organizational information systems, equipment, and the respective operating environments to authorized individuals. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.viii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.1

nodes.title: Monitor Facility
nodes.description: Protect and monitor the physical facility and support infrastructure for organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.2

nodes.title: Escort Visitors
nodes.description: Escort visitors and monitor visitor activity. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 Partial b.1.ix • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.3

nodes.title: Physical Access Logs
nodes.description: Maintain audit logs of physical access. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 Partial b.1.ix • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.4

nodes.title: Manage Physical Access
nodes.description: Control and manage physical access devices. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 Partial b.1.ix • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.5

nodes.title: Alternative Work Sites
nodes.description: Enforce safeguarding measures for CUI at alternate work sites. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.10.6

nodes.title: Risk Assessments
nodes.description: Periodically assess the risk to organizational operations (including mission, functions, image, or reputation), organizational assets, and individuals, resulting from the operation of organizational systems and the associated processing, storage, or transmission of CUI. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.11.1

nodes.title: Vulnerability Scan
nodes.description: Scan for vulnerabilities in organizational systems and applications periodically and when new vulnerabilities affecting those systems and applications are identified. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.11.2

nodes.title: Vulnerability Remediation
nodes.description: Remediate vulnerabilities in accordance with risk assessments. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.11.3

nodes.title: Security Control Assessment
nodes.description: Periodically assess the security controls in organizational systems to determine if the controls are effective in their application. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.12.1

nodes.title: Plan of Action
nodes.description: Develop and implement plans of action designed to correct deficiencies and reduce or eliminate vulnerabilities in organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.12.2

nodes.title: Security Control Monitoring
nodes.description: Monitor security controls on an ongoing basis to ensure the continued effectiveness of the controls. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.12.3

nodes.title: System Security Plan
nodes.description: Develop, document, and periodically update system security plans that describe system boundaries, system environments of operation, how security requirements are implemented, and the relationships with or connections to other systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.12.4

nodes.title: Boundary Protection
nodes.description: Monitor, control, and protect organizational communications (i.e., information transmitted or received by organizational information systems) at the external boundaries and key internal boundaries of the information systems. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.x • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.1

nodes.title: Security Engineering
nodes.description: Employ architectural designs, software development techniques, and systems engineering principles that promote effective information security within organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.2

nodes.title: Role Separation
nodes.description: Separate user functionality from system management functionality. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.3

nodes.title: Shared Resource Control
nodes.description: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.4

nodes.title: Public-Access System Separation
nodes.description: Implement subnetworks for publicly accessible system components that are physically or logically separated from internal networks. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.xi • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.5

nodes.title: Network Communication by Exception
nodes.description: Deny network communications traffic by default and allow network communications traffic by exception (i.e., deny all, permit by exception). • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.6

nodes.title: Split Tunneling
nodes.description: Prevent remote devices from simultaneously establishing non-remote connections with organizational systems and communicating via some other connection to resources in external networks (i.e., split tunneling). • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.7

nodes.title: Data in Transit
nodes.description: Implement cryptographic mechanisms to prevent unauthorized disclosure of CUI during transmission unless otherwise protected by alternative physical safeguards. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.8

nodes.title: Connections Termination
nodes.description: Terminate network connections associated with communications sessions at the end of the sessions or after a defined period of inactivity. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.9

nodes.title: Key Management
nodes.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys for cryptography employed in organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.10

nodes.title: CUI Encryption
nodes.description: Employ FIPS-validated cryptography when used to protect the confidentiality of CUI. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.11

nodes.title: Collaborative Device Control
nodes.description: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and provide indication of devices in use to users present at the device. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.12

nodes.title: Mobile Code
nodes.description: Control and monitor the use of mobile code. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.13

nodes.title: Voice over Internet Protocol
nodes.description: Control and monitor the use of Voice over Internet Protocol (VoIP) technologies. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.14

nodes.title: Communications Authenticity
nodes.description: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.15

nodes.title: Data at Rest
nodes.description: Protect the confidentiality of CUI at rest. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.13.16

nodes.title: Flaw Remediation
nodes.description: Identify, report, and correct information and information system flaws in a timely manner. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.xii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.1

nodes.title: Malicious Code Protection
nodes.description: Provide protection from malicious code at appropriate locations within organizational information systems. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.xiii • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.2

nodes.title: Security Alerts & Advisories
nodes.description: Monitor system security alerts and advisories and take action in response. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.3

nodes.title: Update Malicious Code Protection
nodes.description: Update malicious code protection mechanisms when new releases are available. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.xiv • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.4

nodes.title: System & File Scanning
nodes.description: Perform periodic scans of the information system and real-time scans of files from external sources as files are downloaded, opened, or executed. • FAR Clause 52.204-21 b.1.xv • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.5

nodes.title: Monitor Communications for Attacks
nodes.description: Monitor organizational systems, including inbound and outbound communications traffic, to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.6

nodes.title: Identify Unauthorized Use
nodes.description: Identify unauthorized use of organizational systems. • NIST SP 800-171 Rev 2 3.14.7
